objective: Establish G12's bounded game design and prove its Linux runtime and validation path before feature implementation.
completion_contract: Outcome: inspect the configured ai-game-05 repository and available Linux environment; choose a real 3D engine with rigid-body physics and audio; specify one compact game loop with player agency, threatening opposition, explicit win/loss conditions, and destruction essential to success. Genre is unrestricted. Define module interfaces and a concern-by-concern implementation order, keeping scope within the authorized budget. Evidence: saved design and acceptance checklist, reproducible setup commands, and an actually executed minimal engine scene demonstrating 3D rendering, a falling colliding rotating body, and audio output or a captured audio signal. Validation: rerun the scene and inspect its evidence; distinguish signal generation from audible playback and document how G will perform interactive visual and audible validation. Identify real environmental blockers rather than substituting fabricated evidence.
state_memo: completed: contract validated against referenced artifacts
